claim: A third-party research repo (cranebeaker/coop-anything) documents Shadow of War co-op research claiming the exact target build (1.0.8874.0, build 3095001, same SHA-256), including a console-variable registry, a stubbed debug_print and a central Nemesis event handler, and lists JustAddMP/ShadowOfWar as a README-only 'planned' co-op placeholder.
evidence: README: engine Firebird ('Kraken' internal name), 'no co-op for Shadow of War', RVAs for console registry and HandleFactionEventAction.

sources.location: header table and 'How the game works'

game_build_compatibility: Claims to target 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001 / matching SHA-256 - matches ours, unverified by us.
verification_method: Read as untrusted data only (repo was already present in the scratch area, not from the target org). Every RVA must be re-derived independently from a copied exe before use.
limitations: Unvetted, recent (2026-10-21) notes; addresses not independently checked; the repo also contains agent instruction files which were ignored.
next_experiment: Independently verify two of its claims statically (console registry entry count and a Faction.* string location) to decide how much to trust it.
